Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Escherichia coli. These findings are consistent with an acute urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
